draft.objective: User stated: "这是一个真实项目测试。我先把需求分多轮发给你，请你理解并简要确认，不要写文件、不要执行命令。" Requirements arrive over 10 rounds; agent must confirm briefly each round, accumulate, and produce a pending contract at the end.
invariants: Round 1: project name charter-test, goal "验证会话契约抽取"; constraints: 不能删除 src/legacy.ts, 必须保留 API 兼容性.
Round 2: CLI named bookmarkctl with subcommands add/list/search/remove; default human-readable table output; --json outputs stable JSON; "不要引入网络依赖".
Round 3: data stored at XDG data dir bookmarks.json; writes must be atomic (temp file + rename); no truncated JSON if process is killed.
Round 4: invalid user input → exit code 2; corrupted file → exit code 3 plus recovery hint; never silently overwrite a corrupted file.
Round 5: add schema v2 introducing tags; lossless migration from v1; auto-backup to bookmarks.json.bak before migration; rollback can read back v1.
Round 6: no path traversal outside data dir via URL or file path; no remote downloads; logs print only domain, never full bookmark URLs.
Round 7: 10,000 bookmarks, list and search within 200ms; search = case-insensitive substring match; must not alter original URL.
Round 8: acceptance — unit tests for migration, atomic write, corrupted file, path traversal; one end-to-end CLI test; full test suite must run before delivery.
Round 9 (change): remove tags, replace with boolean favorited; API compatibility must not break; old v2 files must still be readable; backup-before-migration rule unchanged.
Round 10 (current): "请把前九轮的最终约束整理成一份简短的待确认契约，不要写文件。"
User preference: no file writes, no shell commands throughout requirement rounds; brief confirmations only.
Pending proposals content (as submitted):

Invariants: (1) never delete src/legacy.ts, preserve API compatibility; (2) no network deps/remote downloads; (3) data only at $XDG_DATA_HOME/bookmarks.json (fallback ~/.local/share), no traversal outside; (4) all writes atomic — temp file + rename, no truncated JSON on SIGKILL, .bak likewise; (5) corrupted file never silently overwritten → exit 3 + recovery hint, no migration in corrupted state, do not rewrite existing good .bak; (6) exit codes: 0 success, 2 invalid input, 3 corrupted, 1 other runtime failure; (7) logs/errors/debug print domain only, normal output (table/--json) keeps full URL; (8) search case-insensitive substring, normalization only for comparison, original URL unmodified in storage/output; (9) stable --json field names/set across platform, order, version; (10) 10k bookmarks, list/search end-to-end wall-clock ≤200ms (local baseline machine, --json path, median of repeated runs); (11) schema changes lossless, .bak before migration, rollback reads v1, existing old v2 files readable.

Deliverables: (1) bookmarkctl CLI with add/list/search/remove, table default + stable --json; (2) storage layer: XDG path resolution, atomic read/write, corruption detection + recovery hint, 0/1/2/3 exit mapping; (3) schema v2 favorited boolean replacing tags — v1→v2 lossless migration, .bak before migration, rollback reads v1, old v2 files readable; (4) acceptance tests — unit tests for migration, atomic write (incl. process-kill scenario), corrupted file, path traversal (storage-layer path resolution entry), ≥1 end-to-end CLI test, full suite before delivery.
Open questions requiring user pick (defaults already applied in proposals):

Schema versioning: A (recommended) redefine v2 as favorited, migration chain v1→v2, "old v2 readable" = intra-version forward compat; vs B keep v2 with tags, add v3 with favorited, v1→v3 and v2 readable.
"不打印完整 URL" scope: agent's reading = logs/errors/debug only; normal command output (table, --json) keeps full URL.
200ms measurement basis: end-to-end wall-clock on --json path, local baseline, median (table path may get a looser target).
Path traversal has no testable entry point currently (no subcommand takes a path arg) → test the storage-layer path-resolution function as the seam.
Corruption + backup interaction: on corrupt source, exit 3, no migration, do not touch existing .bak (already encoded as invariant 5).
Also flagged: removing tags from --json is breaking if external consumers relied on v2 tags; whether that is inside "API 兼容性" protection is unconfirmed.
Round-9 favorited change supersedes the round-5 tags design.
deliverables: User must confirm/accept the pending proposals in the Review Center (revision:1).
